answer.summary: The ensure-no-git-diff step failed because the formatter rewrote Java files the PR committed unformatted, so git diff is non-empty. The diff reformats GraphExplorationService.java and GraphExplorationSliceTest.java. This is deterministic and will repeat on re-run. Fix: run the project formatter and commit the result.
